## ✨ What feature?
One-line summary of the feature.

## 🤔 Problem / Motivation
What problem does this solve? Why is it needed?

## 💡 Proposed Solution
How would this work? Describe the user experience.

```bash
# Example usage if CLI feature
npx ai-devseed ...
```

## 🎯 Type of Feature
- [ ] New CLI command
- [ ] New template
- [ ] Template improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
What other approaches did you think of?

## 📊 Priority (your view)
- [ ] 🔥 High - blocking my work
- [ ] 🌱 Medium - would be very useful
- [ ] 🌳 Low - nice to have someday

## 💪 Are you willing to contribute?
- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR
- [ ] Yes, but I need guidance
- [ ] No, just suggesting
